root_cause.text: The fallback path in `dump_mac_header()` failed to verify that the MAC header is actually set via `skb_mac_header_was_set()`, allowing an out-of-bounds read when `skb->mac_header` is unset (0xffff) but not equal to `skb->network_header`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `skb_mac_header_was_set(skb)` and replaces the open-coded length test with `skb_mac_header_len()` to ensure the MAC header pointer is valid before dereferencing. The CVE description and commit message explicitly state that the missing check leads to `skb_mac_header(skb)` returning `skb->head + 0xffff` (~64 KiB past buffer) when the MAC header is unset.
